tools.name: ocq_read
tools.description: Read the OpenCode subscription allowance: the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows with percentages and reset times.

endpoint.description: Only this source; omit to read every watched source.

summary.zh: 读 OpenCode 端点的订阅额度:三个窗口的百分比与重置时间。
summary.en: Reads the subscription allowance of OpenCode endpoints: each window’s percentage and reset time.

tools.name: ocq_history
tools.description: Recent allowance trend: sample count, each window’s peak and latest value.

endpoint.description: Only this source; omit for one line per source.

days.description: How many days back, defaulting to 14.

summary.zh: 看最近记录的额度趋势:样本数、峰值与最新值。
summary.en: Recent allowance trend: sample count, peak and latest value.

description.zh: 某个额度窗口刚越过配置的告警线。
description.en: An allowance window just crossed its configured threshold.

description.zh: 某个额度窗口重置了(重置时刻变了)。
description.en: An allowance window reset, which shows as a new reset time.

description.zh: 某个端点的额度从此读不到;同一个原因只报一次。
description.en: An endpoint’s allowance became unreadable; each reason is reported once.

prompts.title: OpenCode 额度 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
OpenCode 额度 World 定时读你正在用的 OpenCode 端点的订阅额度。此刻监控的端点:{{opencode-quota.endpoints}};最紧的一个窗口是 {{opencode-quota.worst}};上次读到的时刻是 {{opencode-quota.lastRead}}。

用户问到额度、还剩多少、还能用多久时,先调用 ocq_read 取此刻的数字再回答;要看趋势就调 ocq_history。这两个工具只读,不消耗额度。

不要主动报额度数字。只有收到额度相关的事件(越过告警线、窗口重置)时,才按事件正文说一句;没收到就别提,也不要定期汇报。
